history.summary: A 560 sqft 1BR at Riviere (Frasers' riverfront luxury project off Havelock/Great World), $1.49M / $2,661 PSF — ~6% below the $2,842 URA median, with a reliable resale-only appreciation of +5.67%/yr over 349 transactions. A premium CCR-edge address with a Greater Southern Waterfront catalyst; the constraint is the high $1.49M quantum and $2,661 PSF for a 1BR.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only appreciation is +5.67%/yr on a deep, reliable 349-txn base (the headline 0.81% is a new-launch-bias artifact the system corrected — use the resale figure). PSF $2,661 is ~6% under the $2,842 median, a fair entry for a young (2023) leasehold luxury project by a top developer on the Singapore River. Havelock MRT (TEL) 580m plus the GSW transformation are strong forward catalysts. Caveat: $1.49M for a 560 sqft 1BR is a steep quantum/PSF that narrows the buyer pool to investors and well-heeled singles.

history.summary: A 560 sqft 1BR asking $1.8M / $3,214 psf — the most expensive of 9 current Riviere 1BR asks (siblings $1.49M–$1.70M / $2,661–$3,034 psf) and ~18% above the project 12-mo median ($2,730 psf). All 34 1BR prints ever are 2021–23 developer new-sales topping out at $3,266 psf (31–40th floor); zero 1BR resales have ever cleared, so this ask is 2023 launch pricing into an untested exit. Gross yield ~3.4% (URA 1BR rents $4.6–5.7k, median ~$5.1k). Under current priors the only validated signals — cheap-vs-peers and region — both read negative: expensive vs own-project comps, and CCR-adjacent $3.2k psf pricing in an RCR district carries CCR-like compression risk (realized fwd CCR +1.9%/yr).
history.rating_rationale: Cheap-vs-peers (the strongest validated forward signal) is strongly negative: priciest of 9 sibling 1BR asks, +18% vs 12-mo project median, asking the 2023 developer top-of-stack print. No 1BR resale has ever transacted — exit untested for a $1.8M investor-only product. ~3.4% gross yield. Prior 2026-06-08 Buy was on a different, cheaper listing ($1.49M/$2,661 psf) and led with +5.67%/yr trailing CAGR, a ~0-forward-power signal under v3.4+ priors; with that stripped and 1-yr appreciation actually -4.0% (momentum -0.96), no thesis survives.
red_flags: Most expensive of 9 current Riviere 1BR asks; ~18% above 12-mo project median PSF
Zero 1BR resale transactions ever (all 34 prints are 2021-23 developer new-sales) — completely untested resale exit
Asks 2023 high-floor developer pricing ($3,180–$3,266 psf prints) with zero appreciation since; project 1-yr appreciation -4.0%, momentum -0.96
$1.8M quantum for a 1BR = niche investor-only buyer pool at a price where 2BRs exist elsewhere
CCR-like $3.2k psf pricing in RCR — compression risk (realized fwd CCR only +1.9%/yr)
catalysts: 580m to Havelock MRT (TE16), Great World adjacency
Greater Southern Waterfront long-run narrative (note: infra/future score backtests ≈0 forward power)
